items.heading: Stamppot
details: Key ingredients: potato, kale, sausage, bacon
Boil potato and kale together until both are soft.
Mash them together into a chunky green mash.
Fry smoked sausage or bacon until browned.
Serve the mash topped with the sausage and its pan juices.

items.heading: Bitterballen
details: Key ingredients: beef ragout, breadcrumbs, egg, mustard
Make a thick, well-seasoned beef ragout and chill it until firm.
Roll the chilled ragout into small balls.
Coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry until golden and serve hot with mustard.
